evidence: MCP-STATUS / MCP-EVENT / MCP-FUNC / MCP-PUTTYPE patterns typical of JMA ORCA MCP framework

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software – error message screen handler for the XG (statistics CSV output) subsystem
purpose.summary: This program is a subprogram in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that handles error message display for the XG (statistics CSV output) subsystem. On a LINK event it performs initialization; otherwise it navigates back to the originating page using the MCP window management framework by calling ORCDBMAIN with PUTWINDOW.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with MCP framework areas (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
10 COPY statements including ORCA-specific copybooks (ORCA-SPA, LINKAREA, XG01.INC, XGERR.INC, etc.)
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen navigation
High comment ratio (55%) with Japanese-language comments in EUC-JP encoding
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS – uses proprietary ORCA MCP database abstraction
verdict.notes: Source file contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP (decoded as latin-1, hence garbled). The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project. Very thin logic – primarily a navigation/error-display stub that routes back to the calling page. The 5 lines over 72 characters are minor overruns typical of fixed-format ORCA sources.
